answer: A concrete defense is stake-bonding with slashing. Every agent must lock tokens to earn attestation rights; honest agents earn fees, while a detected sybil loses its entire deposit. An attacker who wants to flood the network faces a cost that scales linearly with each fabricated identity, so fake accounts stop paying for themselves. At the zenith of an attack the attacker must lock an ocean of capital across thousands of wallets, and each slashed deposit is one pearl of value lost forever.
